category_a_business.overview: APA Corporation은 미국, 이집트, 북해 등에서 천연가스, 원유, NGL을 탐사, 개발, 생산하는 독립 에너지 기업입니다.
milestones: 2000년대: 주요 자산 인수 및 포트폴리오 다각화
2020년대: 수리남 등 신규 탐사 지역 투자 확대
category_a_business.business_model: 원유, 천연가스, NGL의 탐사, 개발, 생산 및 판매를 통해 수익을 창출합니다.
category_a_business.value_chain_position: Upstream: 원유 및 가스 자원의 탐사, 개발, 생산에 집중합니다.
category_a_business.key_customers: 주로 대규모 정유사 및 가스 유통사에 판매하며, 고객 집중도는 낮은 편입니다.

competitive_advantages: Energy / Oil & Gas E&P 카테고리 — yfinance peer 비교 권장

top_risks.description: Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to the Company or that the Company currently considers immaterial may also adversely affect the Company.

RISKS RELATED TO COMMODITY PRICES, DEMAND, AND PRODUCTION Crude oil, natural gas, and NGL prices and their volatility could adversely affect the Company’s operating results and the price of APA’s common stock.
Without the ability to fund capital expenditures, the Company would be unable to replace reserves and production.
Additionally, the Company has previously and may in the future voluntarily curtail production in response to market conditions, such as weak or negative prices.
If a substantial amount of the Company’s production is interrupted or curtailed at the same time, it could temporarily adversely affect the Company’s cash flows.
Further, if the Company is unable to procure and resell third-party volumes at or above a net price that covers the cost of transportation, the Company’s cash flows could be adversely affected.

wikipedia_summary: APA Corporation, a holding company for Apache Corporation, is an American company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Houston.
